lastCompletedStory.title: Resolve doc path-claims against the git-tracked tree (deterministic gate) + tracked-tree regression test

nextStoryContext: US-R2-001 fixed the round-2 CRITICAL: validate-agents-md's path-claim resolution now resolves against the git-tracked tree instead of the live working tree, matching the reviewer's prescribed fix exactly. Replaced resolvesOnDisk(path, cwd) (disk Bun.Glob scan) with resolvesInTrackedTree(path, trackedFiles) (exact/directory-prefix/glob match against `git ls-files` output) plus a git-check-ignore auto-exempt fallback: a path-claim now fails ONLY when it is untracked AND not git-ignored AND not in KNOWN_MISSING. Added makeGetTrackedFiles(cwd)/makeIsIgnored(cwd) as injectable Fn factories (DI pattern mirrors scripts/ratchet-diff.ts's makeGetStagedDiff, using node:child_process spawnSync, not Bun.spawnSync, for consistency with that existing precedent). ValidationOptions gained required `trackedFiles: readonly string[]` and `isIgnored: IsIgnoredFn` fields; all call sites (main() + every test) updated. KNOWN_MISSING pruned from 28 to 20 entries: removed `.claude/.cam-orch-ready`, `scripts/cam/worker-report.json`, `scripts/cam/review-report.json`, `scripts/cam/review-artifact.txt`, and the whole `.claude/.cam-*.json` glob, since every path they covered is a literal/glob .gitignore rule now covered by the auto-exempt (verified each via `git check-ignore -q <path>; echo $?` == 0 before pruning). Did NOT add new KNOWN_MISSING entries for the round-2 reviewer's 4 flagged unresolved citations (scripts/cam/plan-verdict-report.json, .claude/cam-worker-events.jsonl, .claude/cam-loop.local.md, claude-code-harness/) -- all 4 are already gitignored, so the auto-exempt covers them with zero allowlist entries needed. Bare-filename entries (worker-report.json, review-report.json, etc.) stay: confirmed empirically that `git check-ignore` on a bare string does NOT match a directory-qualified .gitignore rule (gitignore patterns with a slash are path-anchored, not basename-matched). Test file rewritten: existing path-claim tests now inject trackedFiles arrays/isIgnored fakes (no real git calls, matching the ratchet-diff.ts DI convention) instead of writeFileSync+disk existence; the `resolvesOnDisk` describe block was renamed/rewritten to test `resolvesInTrackedTree` against plain string arrays. Three NEW regression tests use REAL git plumbing (mkdtempSync + `git init`/`git add`, no fakes) to prove the tracked-tree-vs-working-tree distinction: (1) a git-ignored claim resolves even when the file is absent from the tree (simulating `git archive HEAD`), (2) an untracked-but-physically-present stray file does NOT resolve (the literal determinism defect the old disk-glob code would have gotten wrong), (3) a git-add-ed-but-not-yet-committed file resolves via `git ls-files` (proves staging is enough, no commit needed). Manually verified AC2 end-to-end: built a real tracked-only snapshot via `git archive HEAD | tar -x` + `cp -R .git` + `cp -R node_modules` (a plain `ln -s` for node_modules breaks `git check-ignore` with 'pathspec beyond a symbolic link' -- a symlink node_modules produced a false failure on `node_modules/bun-types/docs/**.mdx` purely from that git limitation, not from this story's logic; the real-copy re-run confirmed exit 0 / gate green with only 3 non-fatal dead-KNOWN_MISSING warnings). `bun run check:all` (all 12 gates) and `bun test` (4517 pass / 0 fail) are green in the normal working tree. Check prd.json for the next story.
